name: instagram-agent
description: Thirteen Claude skills that run an Instagram account: Reels off 26 hook formulas with a scored hook and a timed beat sheet, a research skill that finds what is working in your niche and ranks it by outlier multiple, captions linted against the feed truncation, carousels, stories, profile score, weekly plan, comments, replies, DMs, repurposing, audits, and a humanizer that strips the AI fingerprint before anything ships. Adapted for Brazilian Portuguese and Spanish: every script takes --lang pt|es, with PT/ES lexicons, hook classifiers and caption rules. Adds /ig-hashtag (sized, rotated 3-5 tag sets) and a one-goal-per-post rule in /ig-plan, adapted from sergebulaev/instagram-skills (MIT).
